rules.rule_1_fidelity: 严禁中英文内容不对应，严禁私自改动、更换表述或自作聪明升级表述（如中文未提测试动物时严禁擅自添加 Species: rabbit 等虚构细节）。字面事实必须 100% 精确收敛对齐。
rules.rule_2_concise_professional: 追求最地道、最精简的国际化工合规术语，严格采用冠志官方历史最佳实践译法。

section_1_uses.粘合剂、涂料: Raw material for coatings and adhesives
section_1_uses.用于工业涂料、木器漆、塑料涂料: Used for industrial coatings, wood coatings, and plastic coatings
section_1_uses.应用于服装革、鞋面革、箱包革、柔韧纺织品及塑料的表面涂层，纤维等上浆、纸张印刷、: Surface coating of garment leather, shoe uppers, luggage leather, flexible textiles and plastics; sizing of fibers, paper printing, edge paint for leather and related industries.

section_2_hazards.根据GHS不属于危害化学品: Not classified as hazardous according to GHS
section_2_hazards.根据GHS不属于危险物: This product is not classified as hazardous according to OSHA HazCom 2012 (29 CFR 1910.1200).
section_2_hazards.对水环境有慢性危害，类别 3 (H412): Chronic hazard to water environment, Category 3 (H412)
section_2_hazards.特异性靶器官系统毒性 一次接触，类别 3 (H335): Specific target organ toxicity (single exposure), Category 3 (H335)
section_2_hazards.可能造成皮肤过敏反应: May cause an allergic skin reaction.
section_2_hazards.对水生生物有害并具有长期持续影响: Harmful to aquatic life with long lasting effects.

section_4_first_aid.一般措施：立即脱掉所有被污染的衣物。: General measures: Immediately remove all contaminated clothing.
section_4_first_aid.若意外吞食，不要催吐，立即就医。无意识时，不要经口喂食任何食物。: If accidentally swallowed, do not induce vomiting. Seek medical attention. Do not give anything by mouth to an unconscious person.
section_4_first_aid.立即翻起上下眼睑用大量缓和流动的水清洗眼睛至少20 分钟。且将头倾斜，避免化学品: Immediately lift the upper and lower eyelids and rinse the eyes with plenty of gentle running water for at least 20 minutes. Tilt the head to prevent the chemical from entering the unaffected eye and seek medical attention immediately.
section_4_first_aid.立即用肥皂和大量的水冲洗。若发生皮肤反应，就医。: Immediately wash with soap and plenty of water. If a skin reaction occurs, seek medical advice.
section_4_first_aid.一旦吸入，如有不适，就医。: If inhaled, seek medical advice if discomfort occurs.

section_5_fire_fighting.合适的灭火剂：二氧化碳（CO2），耐醇泡沫，化学干粉。大火时应用水喷洒。: Suitable extinguishing agents: Carbon dioxide (CO2), alcohol-resistant foam, dry chemical powder. Spray with water in case of large fire.
section_5_fire_fighting.不适合的灭火剂：高压水柱。: Unsuitable extinguishing media: High-pressure water jet.
section_5_fire_fighting.特别危险性：热分解可能释放一氧化碳、二氧化碳和氮氧化物。: Special hazards: Thermal decomposition may release carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide, and nitrogen oxides.
section_5_fire_fighting.消防人员防护装备：佩戴自给正压式呼吸器和全身消防防护服。: Protective equipment for firefighters: Wear self-contained breathing apparatus and full protective clothing.

section_6_spill.穿戴个人防护设备。确保足够的通风。: Wear personal protective equipment. Ensure adequate ventilation.
section_6_spill.用惰性吸收材料吸收并按照废弃物处理法规进行处置。: Soak up with inert absorbent material and dispose of in accordance with waste disposal regulations.

section_7_storage.操作后彻底清洗双手。避免接触眼睛和皮肤。提供适当的排风系统。: Wash hands thoroughly after handling. Avoid contact with eyes and skin. Provide appropriate exhaust ventilation.
section_7_storage.保持容器密封，储存在阴凉、干燥和通风良好的地方。避免温度高于+35℃，温度不可低: Keep containers tightly closed in a cool, dry and well-ventilated place. Avoid temperatures above +35°C and below +5°C.
section_7_storage.防冻。远离热源、火花和明火。: Protect from frost. Keep away from heat, sparks and open flames.

section_8_ppe.通常不需要个人呼吸防护设备。如果通风不足，佩戴呼吸保护装置。: Usually no personal respiratory protective equipment is needed. If ventilation is insufficient, wear respiratory protection.

section_9_values.初沸点以下无闪点: No flash point up to initial boiling point.

section_9_values.可以分散于水中: It can be dispersed into water

section_10_stability.在正常储存和操作条件下稳定。: Stable under normal conditions of storage and handling.
section_10_stability.强氧化剂、强酸、强碱。: Strong oxidizing agents, strong acids, strong bases.
section_10_stability.强热、火花、明火。防冻。: Extreme heat, sparks, open flames. Protect from frost.
section_10_stability.热分解可能释放一氧化碳、二氧化碳和氮氧化物。: Thermal decomposition may release carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide, and nitrogen oxides.

section_12_ecology.不要让产品进入下水道、地表水或地下水。: Do not allow product to reach sewage system, surface water or groundwater.

section_13_disposal.必需遵守适用的国标、国家或当地法规进行废弃。在欧盟领域内废弃，应根据欧洲废弃物分: Disposal shall comply with applicable national standards and national or local regulations. Within the European Union, disposal shall comply with the applicable European Waste Catalogue (EWC) regulations.
section_13_disposal.尽可能将容器倒空（例如经倾倒，刮擦或排干直至“滴干”）可根据化学工业现存的回收方: Empty containers as far as possible (for example, by pouring, scraping or draining until dry). Send them to an appropriate collection point under existing recycling schemes in the chemical industry. Recycle containers in accordance with national legislation and environmental regulations. Do not discharge waste through wastewater.

section_14_transport.非危险货物。避免温度高于+35℃，温度不可低于+5℃。远离食物、酸和碱。: Non-dangerous goods. Avoid temperatures above +35°C and below +5°C. Keep away from food, acids and alkalis.
